title: Lumaria ZRO
site: Zreizeda Remote Observatory, Cereceda (Allande, Asturias, Spain)
description: Light-pollution monitoring station; reference camera of the paper.

title: DFN DFNEXT029 “Forrest”
description: Fireball-network camera; astrometric calibration frame of the Madura Cave meteorite fall (19 June 2020).
source: Zenodo 5763497, Fireball data for the Madura Cave meteorite (H. Devillepoix)

title: FRIPON GBWL01
description: Fireball-network video camera; 5 s frame of the Winchcombe meteorite night, with the full Moon rising.
source: Zenodo 6685719, Fireball data for the Winchcombe meteorite (H. Devillepoix, S. McMullan, D. Vida)

title: FRIPON ENSW01
camera: The Imaging Source DMK 23G445, monochrome, 12 bit
description: Fireball-network video camera; noisy 5 s frame, horizon partly blocked by trees and a building.
source: Zenodo 6685719, Fireball data for the Winchcombe meteorite (H. Devillepoix, S. McMullan, D. Vida)

title: Liverpool Telescope SkyCamA
operator: Liverpool Telescope, Liverpool John Moores University
site: Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma (Spain)
description: Sky camera inside the telescope enclosure; the telescope structure occupies the bottom of the field.
credit: Liverpool Telescope Project (non-commercial use with credit)

title: ESO MASCOT
description: Mini All-Sky Cloud Observation Tool of the Paranal Observatory; laser guide star beams cross the field.

title: ESO ALPACA
description: High-resolution sky monitor of the Paranal Observatory; laser guide star beams and the Unit Telescopes in the field.

title: MMT Observatory all-sky camera
operator: MMT Observatory (Smithsonian Institution and University of Arizona)
site: Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory, Mt Hopkins (Arizona, USA)
description: Observatory sky monitor; the FITS file stores the sky mirrored, which the calibration detects.
source: MMT Observatory public all-sky camera archive
